::: {#contact-heading}

I'm always happy to hear from fellow ecologists, conservation practitioners, and anyone working on biodiversity monitoring. I'm especially keen to connect on:

- Biodiversity trends in Czechia, condition assessment of protected species, and the impacts of conservation interventions
- Amphibian, bat, and aquatic invertebrate monitoring and conservation in Europe, through the [BiodivPond pilot](https://biodivpond.github.io)
- Faunistics of European dung beetles, especially latitudinal range shifts
- Translating R workflows in [host_naturecz](https://github.com/BiodivMonCZ/host_naturecz/) to SQL

The best way to reach me is by [email](mailto:jonas.gaigr@gmail.com). You can also find me on the channels below.

:::
